card.name: Linking words in rehabilitation and therapy text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (commas, 'of', 'involve', 'new', 'says') inside passages about brain injury, rehabilitation, therapy devices and exercise training, where a word like rehabilitation or training could come next.
